summary.en: One character speaks only gibberish; everyone else understands perfectly.
summary.no: Én karakter snakker bare gibberish; alle andre forstår perfekt.

en: The others treat every word as completely clear and answer it.
no: De andre behandler hvert ord som helt klart og svarer på det.

more.en: The others decide what the gibberish meant, so they shape the story. The gibberish player should commit to their intentions.
more.no: De andre bestemmer hva gibberishen betydde, så de former historien. Gibberish-spilleren bør gå helt inn i intensjonene sine.
